review_candidates.title: Senior React Native Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Safra Safra is an AI-first travel platform. A traveler describes their trip and gets a personalized, bookable itinerary in seconds, then book the trip in the app. We serve GCC travelers in Arabic and English. The role Own the development on our React Native apps (iOS + Android) alongside our backend engineers. Hands-on senior work, architecture decisions and shipped code. You'll pick up a production codebase, work independently, and raise the bar as you go. What you'll work on Booking flows end to end: search, results, cart, checkout, payment, confirmation The AI trip planner: streaming conversational UI, voice input, maps, generated itineraries Arabic and RTL as first-class: mirrored layouts, Arabic typography, direction-aware navigation Release engineering: EAS build/submit, native config plugins, store submissions Performance and stability: list rendering, animations, cold start, crash reporting What we're looking for 5+ years mobile, substantial React Native + TypeScript Comfortable below the JS layer: Expo config plugins, native modules, Xcode/Gradle build failures State management judgment — can work in an existing store without rewriting it Shipped a real payment or checkout flow Self-directed: takes an ambiguous ticket, asks the right questions, returns working code Clear written English — we're remote and async

review_candidates.title: Backend Engineer, EGYPT
review_candidates.description: About nsave nsave is a fintech company headquartered in London. Founded by Amer Baroudi and Abdallah AbuHashem, our vision is to "Protect and grow the wealth of the financially excluded". We have built a global platform that provide trusted USD accounts, global payments, and investments for individuals from distressed economies, where inflation is high and banking systems are unstable. Our compliance-by-design approach and proprietary technology allow us to deliver these services securely and at scale. To date, nsave has raised $22M from leading investors including Sequoia Capital, TQ Ventures, Y Combinator, and SV Angel. Our team has grown 200% in the last year, and with so much more ahead, we're just getting started! Learn more at www.nsave.com . 📍 Location: Egypt (Cairo preferred) 🧾 Engagement Type: Independent Contractor About the Role As our Backend Engineer , you will build and scale the infrastructure powering nsave's financial services. Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you'll own critical backend subsystems — from service architecture and reliability to security and compliance integrations — serving tens of thousands of users across multiple jurisdictions. Who You Are Strong engineering fundamentals: You build and optimise software systems with solid knowledge of clean architecture, layered abstractions, and complexity tradeoffs Broad platform knowledge: You're comfortable across backend architecture, databases, site reliability, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD Security-minded: You can design and manage robust financial systems with high security and compliance requirements Business-oriented: Your technical decisions are informed by product and business context, and you know how to balance speed with quality How You'll Make a Difference Design, implement, and own critical infrastructure — including service architecture, reliability, build and release, and integration with compliance and banking services Proactively improve system health by identifying weak spots in the codebase and infrastructure, and prioritising fixes Collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to ship features across multiple markets Contribute to engineering best practices, code quality, and process improvements as we scale What We're Looking For Experience in backend engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles Proficiency in backend languages and frameworks relevant to scalable financial systems Ability to operate independently and execute in fast-moving environments Experience in startups, fintech, or regulated environments is strongly preferred nsave Values Alongside professional excellence, we look for people whose values align with ours: Service — "Mission First": We put the mission, our customers, and our team above self. Urgency — "Stay focused. Move fast": We act with urgency and intention, concentrating on what matters most. Ownership — "Act as an Owner": We take responsibility for outcomes end-to-end. Standards — "Pursue Excellence": We hold ourselves to high personal standards and continuously improve. Please apply only if you: Are deeply motivated by nsave's mission and the problems we are solving Thrive in high-ownership, high-accountability environments Are comfortable operating with urgency and ambiguity Want to build from first principles in an early-stage, high-growth company Contractor Classification Notice This role is offered on a freelance / independent contractor basis. Contractors are not employees of nsave and are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and statutory obligations. nsave is an equal opportunity organisation. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
